sentences.zh: 長女為真宗德妃，加贈定國軍節度兼侍中。

translations.literal: His eldest daughter was Zhenzong's Virtuous Consort; Tong was further posthumously made military commissioner of Dingguo Army and concurrent Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Eldest daughter was Zhenzong's Virtuous Consort; Tong was further posthumously military commissioner of Dingguo and Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符五年，德妃正位中宮，又贈維嶽忠正軍節度、檢校太傅，延慶彰德軍節度、檢校太尉，通永興軍節度兼中書令，追封曾祖母宋氏吳國太夫人，祖母河南縣君元氏許國太夫人，母龐氏徐國太夫人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dazhong Xiangfu when the Virtuous Consort became empress, Weiyue was further posthumously military commissioner of Zhongzheng Army and acting Grand Preceptor, Yanqing military commissioner of Zhangde and acting Grand Marshal, Tong military commissioner of Yongxing and concurrent Director of the Secretariat; great-grandmother Lady Song was posthumously Grand Lady of Wu, grandmother County Lady Yuan of Henan was Grand Lady of Xu, mother Lady Pang was Grand Lady of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong Xiangfu 5 when the Virtuous Consort became empress, ancestors were posthumously ennobled: Weiyue Zhongzheng military commissioner and acting Grand Preceptor, Yanqing Zhangde and acting Grand Marshal, Tong Yongxing and Director of the Secretariat; wives were posthumously ennobled.

sentences.zh: 初，通之卒，窆京城西。

translations.literal: Earlier when Tong died he was buried west of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Tong died he was buried west of the capital.

sentences.zh: 天禧二年，詔贈太師、尚書令，諡武懿，七月，遣升王府諮議參軍張士遜具鹵簿鼓吹，改葬於祥符鄧公原。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianxi an edict posthumously made him Grand Preceptor and Director of the Department of State Affairs, posthumous name Wuyi; in the seventh month Zhang Shisun, advisory official of the Heir Apparent's establishment, was sent with full guard of honor to rebury at Xiangfu Deng Duke's plain.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianxi 2 an edict posthumously made him Grand Preceptor and Director of the Department of State Affairs, posthumous Wuyi; month 7 Zhang Shisun was sent with full honor guard to rebury at Xiangfu Deng Duke's plain.

sentences.zh: 皇后親臨奠，真宗御製祭文置靈坐右。

translations.literal: The empress personally attended the offering; Zhenzong composed sacrificial text and placed it to the right of the spirit seat.
translations.idiomatic: The empress personally mourned; Zhenzong composed sacrificial text placed by the spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符二年，護屯兵於漢州，曆遷供奉官，徒嘉州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu he protected troops at Han and was promoted repeatedly to attendant officer and moved to Jia.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong Xiangfu 2 he protected troops at Han, rose to attendant officer, moved to Jia.

sentences.zh: 士卒有病皆給醫藥，親察視撫循之。

translations.literal: When soldiers were ill he all gave medicine and personally inspected and comforted them.
translations.idiomatic: When soldiers were ill he gave medicine and personally comforted them.

sentences.zh: 召還，改內殿崇班，提點在京倉場、東西八作司，以舉職聞，遷洛苑副使。

translations.literal: Recalled, he was changed to Inner Hall Honored Class and investigated capital granaries and east-west Eight Workshops and was known for fulfilling duty; promoted Vice Commissioner of Luoyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled, he was Inner Hall Honored Class, investigated capital granaries and Eight Workshops, known for duty; promoted Vice Luoyuan Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八年，預修大內，以勞改南作坊使、同勾當皇城司。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he took part in repairing the great inner palace; for labor he was changed to Southern Workshops Commissioner and concurrent overseer of the Imperial City Office.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he repaired the great inner palace; for labor he was Southern Workshops Commissioner and concurrent Imperial City overseer.

sentences.zh: 天禧初，遷洛苑使，領勤州刺史，與周懷政聯職。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianxi he was promoted Luoyuan Commissioner and held Qin Prefecture and was linked in office with Zhou Huai Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: At Tianxi's start he was Luoyuan Commissioner and held Qin, linked with Zhou Huai Zheng.

sentences.zh: 懷政奸恣，美未嘗阿附，懷政左右有過，必痛繩之。

translations.literal: Huai Zheng was treacherous and arrogant; Mei never flattered him and when Huai Zheng's attendants erred he always punished them severely.
translations.idiomatic: Huai Zheng was treacherous; Mei never flattered him and severely punished his attendants' faults.

sentences.zh: 親從卒偵邏者多不時更易，美按籍分番次均使焉。

translations.literal: Close attendants on patrol were often not changed on schedule; Mei checked the register and assigned turns evenly.
translations.idiomatic: Close attendants on patrol were not rotated on schedule; Mei checked the register and assigned turns evenly.

sentences.zh: 上屢欲委之兵柄，以皇后懇讓故，中輟者數四。

translations.literal: The emperor several times wished to give him military command but because the empress earnestly declined it was stopped four times.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor several times wished to give him military command but the empress earnestly declined four times.

sentences.zh: 三年，授龍神衛四廂都指揮使，領昭州防禦使，改侍衛馬軍都虞候。

translations.literal: In the third year he was made commander of the four wings of the Dragon Divine Guard and defender of Zhao and changed to Vice Commander of the Palace Attendant Horse Army.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 he was commander of four Dragon Divine Guard wings, defender of Zhao, and Vice Commander of Palace Attendant Horse Army.

sentences.zh: 五年，加武勝軍節度觀察留後。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was given observation commissioner of Wusheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he was observation commissioner of Wusheng Army.

sentences.zh: 卒，年六十。

translations.literal: He died, aged sixty.
translations.idiomatic: He died, aged sixty.

sentences.zh: 廢朝三日，贈太尉、昭德軍節度，錄其子從德供備庫使，從廣內殿崇班，旁親遷補者數人，追封美亡妻宋氏河內郡夫人。

translations.literal: Court was suspended three days; posthumously Grand Marshal and military commissioner of Zhaode Army; his son Congde was made Supply Commissioner and Congguang Inner Hall Honored Class; several collateral kin were promoted; deceased wife Lady Song was posthumously Lady of Henei Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Court suspended three days; posthumously Grand Marshal and Zhaode military commissioner; son Congde Supply Commissioner, Congguang Inner Hall Honored Class; collateral kin promoted; wife Lady Song posthumously Lady of Henei.

sentences.zh: 仁宗嗣位，尊皇后為皇太后，贈維嶽鎮寧軍節度兼侍中，延慶建雄軍節度兼中書令，通彭城郡王，曾祖母宋氏陳國太夫人，祖母元氏衛國太夫人。

translations.literal: When Renzong succeeded the empress was honored empress dowager; Weiyue was further posthumously military commissioner of Zhenning and Palace Attendant, Yanqing Jianxiong military commissioner and Director of the Secretariat, Tong Prince of Pengcheng; great-grandmother Lady Song Grand Lady of Chen, grandmother Lady Yuan Grand Lady of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong succeeded, empress became dowager; ancestors further ennobled; great-grandmother Lady Song Grand Lady of Chen, grandmother Lady Yuan Grand Lady of Wei.

sentences.zh: 母龐氏鄆國太夫人，美亦贈侍中。

translations.literal: Mother Lady Pang Grand Lady of Yun; Mei was also posthumously Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Mother Lady Pang Grand Lady of Yun; Mei was also posthumously Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 天聖二年，郊祀，加贈維嶽彰信軍節度兼中書令，延慶鎮安軍節度兼中書令，通鄭王，宋氏楚國太夫人，元氏韓國太夫人，龐氏魏國太夫人。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiansheng on suburban sacrifice Weiyue was further posthumously Zhangxin military commissioner and Director of the Secretariat, Yanqing Zhen'an military commissioner and Director of the Secretariat, Tong Prince of Zheng, Lady Song Grand Lady of Chu, Lady Yuan Grand Lady of Han, Lady Pang Grand Lady of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Tiansheng 2 suburban sacrifice: ancestors further ennobled; Lady Song Grand Lady of Chu, Lady Yuan of Han, Lady Pang of Wei.

sentences.zh: 五年，再郊，又贈維嶽天平軍節度、中書令兼尚書令，延慶彰化軍節度、許國公，通開府儀同三司、魏王，宋氏安國太夫人，元氏齊國太夫人，龐氏晉國太夫人，從德和州刺史，從廣內殿承製。

translations.literal: In the fifth year on second suburban sacrifice again Weiyue was Tianping military commissioner and Director of the Secretariat and Director of the Department of State Affairs, Yanqing Zhanghua military commissioner and Duke of Xu, Tong Commissioner with same rank as Three Excellencies and Duke of Wei, Lady Song Grand Lady of An, Lady Yuan Grand Lady of Qi, Lady Pang Grand Lady of Jin; Congde prefect of He, Congguang Inner Hall Fabricator.
translations.idiomatic: Tiansheng 5 second suburban sacrifice: again ancestors ennobled; Congde prefect of He, Congguang Inner Hall Fabricator.

sentences.zh: 有龔知進者，即通之友婿也，亦贈衛尉卿，其妻追封南安郡君。

translations.literal: There was Gong Zhijin who was Tong's friend by marriage and was also posthumously Commandant of the Guards; his wife was posthumously Lady of Nan'an Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Zhijin, Tong's friend by marriage, was also posthumously Commandant of the Guards; his wife posthumously Lady of Nan'an.

sentences.zh: 從德字復本，父美卒，年十四，自殿直遷至供備庫副使。

translations.literal: Congde, style Fuben, when Mei died was fourteen; from Palace Attendant he rose to Vice Supply Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Congde, style Fuben, when Mei died was fourteen; from Palace Attendant he rose to Vice Supply Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 弟從廣是歲始生，亦補西頭供奉官，遷內殿崇班。

translations.literal: Younger brother Congguang was born that year and was also made Western Head attendant officer and promoted Inner Hall Honored Class.
translations.idiomatic: Younger brother Congguang born that year was also made Western Head attendant officer and Inner Hall Honored Class.

sentences.zh: 太后臨朝，從德以崇儀使真拜恩州刺史，改和州，又遷蔡州團練使，出知衛州，改恩州兵馬都總管，知相州。

translations.literal: When the empress dowager held court Congde was truly made regimental commander of En and changed to He and again Cai regimental commander; he went out as prefect of Wei and was changed to En supreme commander and military commander and governed Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager held court Congde was made regimental commander of En, then He, then Cai; he governed Wei, then was En supreme commander and governed Xiang.

sentences.zh: 從德齒少無才能，特以外家故，恩寵無比。

translations.literal: Congde was young without ability but because of the maternal clan received matchless favor.
translations.idiomatic: Congde was young and without ability but through the maternal clan received matchless favor.

sentences.zh: 其在衛州，縣吏李熙輔者善事從德，乃薦其才於朝。

translations.literal: At Wei a county clerk Li Xifu who was good at serving Congde recommended his talent to court.
translations.idiomatic: At Wei county clerk Li Xifu who served Congde well recommended his talent to court.

sentences.zh: 太后喜曰：「兒能薦士，知所以為政矣。」

translations.literal: The empress dowager was pleased and said: 'The boy can recommend scholars—he knows how to govern.'
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager was pleased and said: 'My son can recommend men—he knows how to govern.'

sentences.zh: 即擢熙輔京官。

translations.literal: He was at once promoted Xifu to capital official.
translations.idiomatic: Xifu was at once promoted capital official.

sentences.zh: 從事鄭驤因緣從德，亦擢美官。

translations.literal: Attendant Zheng Xiang through Congde's connection was also promoted to a fine office.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Zheng Xiang through Congde was also promoted to a fine office.

sentences.zh: 從德妻，嘉州王蒙正女也。

translations.literal: Congde's wife was daughter of Jia Prefecture's Wang Mengzheng.
translations.idiomatic: Congde's wife was daughter of Wang Mengzheng of Jia.

sentences.zh: 蒙正家豪右，以厚賂結納至郎官，為郡守。

translations.literal: Mengzheng's family was powerful; with thick bribes he connected and rose to court official and was a prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng's family was powerful; with bribes he rose to court official and prefect.

sentences.zh: 既而從德病，召還，道卒，年二十四。

translations.literal: Later Congde fell ill and was recalled; he died on the road, aged twenty-four.
translations.idiomatic: Later Congde fell ill, was recalled, and died on the road, aged twenty-four.

sentences.zh: 贈保寧軍節度使，封榮國公，諡康懷。

translations.literal: Posthumously military commissioner of Baoning Army, enfeoffed Duke of Rong, posthumous name Kanghuai.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously military commissioner of Baoning Army, enfeoffed Duke of Rong, posthumous Kanghuai.

sentences.zh: 太后悲憐之尤甚，錄內外姻戚門人及僮隸數十人。

translations.literal: The empress dowager pitied him especially and enrolled several dozen consort kin, retainers, and servants.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager pitied him especially and enrolled dozens of kin, retainers, and servants.

sentences.zh: 從德娣婿龍圖閣直學士馬季良、母越國夫人錢氏兄惟演子集賢校理曖及蒙正皆遷二官。

translations.literal: Congde's brother-in-law Longtu Pavilion Academician Ma Jiliang, mother's elder brother Qian Weiyan's son Proofreader Ai and Mengzheng were all promoted two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Brother-in-law Ma Jiliang, uncle Qian Weiyan's son Proofreader Ai, and Mengzheng were all promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 尚書屯田員外郎戴融嘗佐從德衛州，以為三司度支判官。

translations.literal: Ministry of Revenue Outer Section Officer Dai Rong had once assisted Congde at Wei and was made Three Departments Expenditure Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue Officer Dai Rong who had assisted Congde at Wei was made Three Departments Expenditure Vice Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 御史曹修古、楊偕、郭勸、推直官段少連上疏論之，皆坐貶。

translations.literal: Censors Cao Xiugu, Yang Xie, Guo Quan, and investigating officer Duan Shaolian memorialized; all were demoted.
translations.idiomatic: Censors Cao Xiugu, Yang Xie, Guo Quan, and investigator Duan Shaolian memorialized; all were demoted.

sentences.zh: 子永年。

translations.literal: His son Yongnian.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yongnian.

sentences.zh: 從廣字景元，少出入禁中，侍仁宗左右，太后愛之如家人子。

translations.literal: Congguang, style Jingyuan, from youth went in and out of the forbidden palace and attended Renzong's side; the empress dowager loved him like a family child.
translations.idiomatic: Congguang, style Jingyuan, from youth entered the forbidden palace and attended Renzong; the empress dowager loved him like family.

sentences.zh: 太后崩，真拜崇州團練使。

translations.literal: When the empress dowager died he was truly made regimental commander of Chong.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager died he was made regimental commander of Chong.

sentences.zh: 娶荊王元儼女。

translations.literal: He married the daughter of Prince Jing of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: He married Prince Jing of Jing's daughter.

sentences.zh: 為滁州防禦使，時年十七。

translations.literal: He was defender of Chu; he was then seventeen.
translations.idiomatic: He was defender of Chu at seventeen.

sentences.zh: 趙元昊反，從廣自言待罪行間，不能扞患疆埸，坐耗縣官，願上所給公使錢，帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: When Zhao Yuanhao rebelled Congguang said he awaited punishment and could not defend the border and wasted official funds and wished to return the allotted public funds; the emperor praised and accepted.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Yuanhao rebelled Congguang said he awaited punishment, could not defend the border, wasted funds, and offered to return his public allowance; the emperor praised this.

sentences.zh: 為群牧都監，改副使。

translations.literal: He was Herd Commissioner and changed to Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was Herd Commissioner, then Vice Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 從廣自為防禦使十年不遷，特拜宣州觀察使、同勾當三班院，請補外自效，以知洺州。

translations.literal: Congguang had been defender ten years without promotion; he was specially made observation commissioner of Xuan and concurrent overseer of the Third Class Office and asked to serve outside to prove himself and was made prefect of Luo.
translations.idiomatic: Defender ten years without promotion; specially made Xuan observation commissioner and Third Class overseer; he asked to serve outside and was made prefect of Luo.

sentences.zh: 漳水溢，從廣穿隋故渠以殺水勢，洺人便之。

translations.literal: When the Zhang River overflowed Congguang cut the Sui old canal to reduce the water force; the people of Luo found it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhang overflowed Congguang cut the Sui old canal to reduce flooding; Luo people benefited.

sentences.zh: 徙邢州，籍鄉軍之罷老者聽引子弟自代，著為令。

translations.literal: Moved to Xing; he registered aged local troops and allowed them to bring sons and younger brothers as substitutes and made it regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Moved to Xing; he registered aged local troops to bring sons as substitutes and made it law.

sentences.zh: 召還，復領三班院。

translations.literal: Recalled; again oversaw the Third Class Office.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled; again oversaw the Third Class Office.

sentences.zh: 出知襄州，徙真定府路馬步軍副都總管。

translations.literal: He went out as prefect of Xiang and was moved to deputy supreme commander of horse and foot of Zhendingfu route.
translations.idiomatic: He governed Xiang and was deputy supreme commander of Zhendingfu horse and foot.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈昭慶軍節度使，諡良惠。

translations.literal: He died; posthumously military commissioner of Zhaoqing Army, posthumous name Lianghui.
translations.idiomatic: He died; posthumously Zhaoqing military commissioner, posthumous Lianghui.

sentences.zh: 從廣性謹飭，然喜交士大夫，時頗稱之。

translations.literal: Congguang was cautious by nature yet liked to associate with scholar-officials and was praised in his time.
translations.idiomatic: Congguang was cautious yet liked scholar-officials and was praised.

sentences.zh: 永年字君錫，生四歲，授內殿崇班，許出入兩宮。

translations.literal: Yongnian, style Junxi, at four was made Inner Hall Honored Class and allowed in and out of both palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Yongnian, style Junxi, at four was Inner Hall Honored Class and allowed in both palaces.

sentences.zh: 仁宗使賦《小山詩》，有「一柱擎天」之語。

translations.literal: Renzong had him compose the 'Small Mountain' poem with the phrase 'a single pillar holding up heaven.'
translations.idiomatic: Renzong had him compose 'Small Mountain' with the phrase 'a single pillar holding up heaven.'

sentences.zh: 帝誤投金杯瑤津亭下，戲謂左右曰：「能取之乎？」

translations.literal: The emperor mistakenly dropped a gold cup at Yaojin Pavilion and jested to attendants: 'Can anyone fetch it?'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor dropped a gold cup at Yaojin Pavilion and jested: 'Can anyone fetch it?'

sentences.zh: 永年一躍持之而出，帝拊其首曰：「奇童子也。」

translations.literal: Yongnian leaped once, held it out, and came out; the emperor patted his head and said: 'What a remarkable boy.'
translations.idiomatic: Yongnian leaped, fetched it, and came out; the emperor patted his head: 'What a remarkable boy.'

sentences.zh: 常置內中，年十二，始聽出外，累遷廉州團練使，為陝州都監。

translations.literal: He was often kept inside; at twelve he was first allowed outside; promoted repeatedly to regimental commander of Lian and was Shaanxi supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: Often kept inside; at twelve allowed outside; rose to Lian regimental commander and Shaanxi supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 郭邈山等為盜，永年密遣壯士夜渡河，殺其凶桀二十餘人，眾遂散。

translations.literal: When Guo Miaoshan and others were bandits Yongnian secretly sent stalwarts by night across the river and killed over twenty ringleaders; the crowd dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: When Guo Miaoshan and others were bandits Yongnian secretly sent men by night across the river, killed over twenty ringleaders, and the crowd dispersed.

sentences.zh: 遷鈐轄，代還召見，問破賊狀，擢幹辦皇城司，改單州團練使、永興軍路總管。

translations.literal: Promoted stationed commander; on return summoned and asked how he broke the bandits; promoted to manage the Imperial City Office; changed to regimental commander of Shan and Yongxing route supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted stationed commander; recalled and asked about the bandits; promoted Imperial City manager; made Shan regimental commander and Yongxing supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 契丹遣使來請帝繪像，選副張報使。

translations.literal: The Khitan sent envoys requesting the emperor's painted portrait; chosen as deputy to Zhang on the response embassy.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan requested the emperor's portrait; chosen deputy to Zhang on the response embassy.

sentences.zh: 契丹以未得志，夜取巨石塞驛門，眾皆恐，永年素有力，手擲棄之，契丹驚以為神。

translations.literal: The Khitan, not having achieved their aim, at night took great stones to block the post station gate; all were afraid; Yongnian had always been strong and threw them aside by hand; the Khitan were amazed and thought it divine.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan at night blocked the post gate with stones; all feared; Yongnian threw them aside; the Khitan thought it divine.

sentences.zh: 出知涇州，帝賜詩寵之。

translations.literal: He went out as prefect of Jing; the emperor bestowed a poem honoring him.
translations.idiomatic: He governed Jing; the emperor bestowed an honoring poem.

sentences.zh: 郡兵歲以香藥為折支，三司不時輦致。

translations.literal: Border troops yearly took spices and medicine as partial pay; the Three Departments did not timely transport them.
translations.idiomatic: Border troops yearly took spices as partial pay; the Three Departments did not deliver in time.

sentences.zh: 振武卒素驕，突入通判聽事，請以他物代給，歡嘩語不遜。

translations.literal: Zhenwu soldiers were always arrogant; they burst into the vice prefect's hall and asked for other goods in substitution, clamoring rudely.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenwu soldiers were arrogant; they burst into the vice prefect's hall demanding other goods, clamoring rudely.

sentences.zh: 永年召至庭下數其罪，斬為首二人，餘不敢動。

translations.literal: Yongnian summoned them to the courtyard, counted their crimes, and beheaded two as leaders; the rest dared not move.
translations.idiomatic: Yongnian summoned them, counted crimes, beheaded two leaders; the rest dared not move.

sentences.zh: 同提舉在京諸司庫務。

translations.literal: Concurrently investigated capital various storehouses.
translations.idiomatic: Concurrently investigated capital storehouses.

sentences.zh: 凡三除防禦使，皆為言者所論而寢。

translations.literal: Three times made defender; each time critics memorialized and it was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Three times made defender; each time critics stopped it.

sentences.zh: 知代州。

translations.literal: He governed Dai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He governed Dai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 契丹取西山木積十餘里，輦載相屬於路，前守不敢遏，永年遣人焚之，一夕盡。

translations.literal: The Khitan took western mountain timber piled over ten li; carts loaded continuously on the road; previous guardians dared not stop them; Yongnian sent men to burn it all in one night.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan piled western mountain timber for over ten li; previous guardians dared not stop them; Yongnian burned it in one night.

sentences.zh: 上其事，帝稱善。

translations.literal: He reported upward; the emperor praised it.
translations.idiomatic: He reported; the emperor praised it.

sentences.zh: 契丹移檄捕縱火盜，永年曰：「盜固有罪，然發在我境，何預汝事？」

translations.literal: The Khitan moved a proclamation to capture the arson thief; Yongnian said: 'The thief is guilty, but the fire started in our territory—what business is it of yours?'
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan proclaimed to capture the arsonist; Yongnian said: 'The thief is guilty, but the fire was in our territory—what is it to you?'

sentences.zh: 乃不敢復言。

translations.literal: They dared not speak again.
translations.idiomatic: They dared not speak again.

sentences.zh: 帝嘗問禦戎策，對合旨，書「忠孝」字以賜。

translations.literal: The emperor once asked border defense strategy; his answer suited intent and he was given the characters 'Loyal and Filial.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked border strategy; his answer suited intent and he received 'Loyal and Filial.'

sentences.zh: 英宗立，遷沂州防禦使，復知代州。

translations.literal: When Yingzong succeeded he was moved to defender of Yi and again governed Dai.
translations.idiomatic: When Yingzong succeeded he was defender of Yi and again governed Dai.

sentences.zh: 曆步軍馬軍殿前都虞候、太原定州路副都總管。

translations.literal: He successively was Vice Commander of Foot Army, Horse Army, and Palace Front, and deputy supreme commander of Taiyuan-Ding route.
translations.idiomatic: He was Vice Commander of Foot, Horse, and Palace Front Armies and deputy supreme commander of Taiyuan-Ding route.

sentences.zh: 王師征安南，永年請先士卒，度富良江取賊以獻，不許。

translations.literal: When the army campaigned against Annan Yongnian asked to lead the vanguard, cross the Fu Liang River and take the enemy to present; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the Annan campaign Yongnian asked to lead the vanguard, cross Fu Liang River and capture the enemy; refused.

sentences.zh: 遷邕州觀察使、步軍副都指揮使。

translations.literal: He was moved to observation commissioner of Yong and Vice Commander of the Foot Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was Yong observation commissioner and Foot Army Vice Commander.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈崇信軍節度使，諡曰莊恪。

translations.literal: He died; posthumously military commissioner of Chongxin Army, posthumous name Zhuangke.
translations.idiomatic: He died; posthumously Chongxin military commissioner, posthumous Zhuangke.

sentences.zh: 馬季良字元之，開封府尉氏人。

translations.literal: Ma Jiliang, style Yuanzhi, was a native of Weishi in Kaifeng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Jiliang, style Yuanzhi, was from Weishi in Kaifeng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 家本茶商，娶劉美女。

translations.literal: The family were originally tea merchants and he married Lady Liu the Beautiful.
translations.idiomatic: The family were tea merchants; he married Lady Liu the Beautiful.

sentences.zh: 初補越州上虞尉，改秘書省校書郎，知明州鄞縣，入為刑部詳覆官。

translations.literal: He first served as captain of Shangyu in Yue, changed to Proofreader of the Secretariat, governed Yin County in Ming, and entered as detailed reviewer of the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He first was Shangyu captain in Yue, Secretariat Proofreader, Yin county magistrate in Ming, then Punishments detailed reviewer.

sentences.zh: 太后臨朝，遷光祿寺丞。

translations.literal: When the empress dowager held court he was promoted Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager held court he was Director of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 頃之，擢秘閣校理、同判太常禮院，再遷太子中允、判三司度支勾院，以太常丞、直史館提舉在京諸司庫務，擢龍圖閣待制。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted Secretariat collator and concurrent judge of the Grand Imperial Rites Court, again promoted Crown Prince Attendant and judge of Three Departments Expenditure Office, as Grand Sacrifices Director and Direct Historian he supervised capital storehouses, and was promoted Longtu Pavilion Attendant Academician.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Secretariat collator and Rites Court judge, Crown Prince Attendant and Expenditure judge, Grand Sacrifices Director and Historian supervising storehouses, Longtu Attendant Academician.

sentences.zh: 三丞充近職，非故事也。

translations.literal: Three such posts as near office—this was not precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Three near-office posts—not precedent.

sentences.zh: 遷尚書工部員外郎、龍圖閣直學士、同知審官院。

translations.literal: He was promoted Ministry of Works Outer Section Officer, Longtu Direct Academician, and concurrent judge of the Review Office.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted Works Outer Section Officer, Longtu Direct Academician, Review Office judge.

sentences.zh: 劉從德卒，遺表季良遷二官，辭不就，而請以其子直方為館閣讀書。

translations.literal: When Liu Congde died his testament wished Jiliang promoted two ranks; he declined and asked that his son Zhifang study in the pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: When Congde died his will wished Jiliang promoted two ranks; he declined and asked son Zhifang study in the pavilion.

sentences.zh: 會江南旱，出為安撫使，再遷兵部郎中。

translations.literal: When Jiangnan suffered drought he went out as pacification commissioner and was again promoted Military Affairs Langzhong.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangnan droughted he was pacification commissioner and promoted Military Affairs Langzhong.

sentences.zh: 太后崩，換濠州防禦使，赴本州。

translations.literal: When the empress dowager died he was changed to defender of Hao and went to that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager died he was defender of Hao.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞範諷言季良徼幸得官，降屯衛將軍、滁州安置。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Fan Feng said Jiliang gained office by luck and was demoted Tunwei General and settled at Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Fan Feng said Jiliang gained office by luck; demoted Tunwei General, settled at Chu.

sentences.zh: 開封府劾奏季良冒立券，庇占富民劉守謙免戶役，詔許季良自陳，以地給還。

translations.literal: Kaifeng Prefecture impeached Jiliang for falsely issuing bonds and shielding the wealthy Liu Shouqian from household service; an edict allowed Jiliang to explain himself and the land was returned.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifeng impeached him for false bonds and shielding Liu Shouqian from service; allowed to explain; land returned.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，徙壽州，致仕，還京師卒。

translations.literal: After over a year he was moved to Shou and retired; he returned to the capital and died.
translations.idiomatic: After a year moved to Shou, retired, returned to capital and died.

sentences.zh: 季良因緣以進，無他行能，在禮院嘗建言，攝祠事官致齋三日無供帳飲食，非所以重祠事也。

translations.literal: Jiliang advanced through connections without other ability; in the Rites Court he once memorialized that acting sacrifice officers should fast three days without provisions or food—not how to honor sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Jiliang advanced by connections; in Rites Court he memorialized acting sacrifice officers should fast three days without food—not honoring sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 自是翰林、儀鸞司供帳，大官給食於祠所雲。

translations.literal: From then Hanlin and Ceremonial Guard provided provisions and the Grand Commissary gave food at the sacrifice site.
translations.idiomatic: Thence Hanlin and Ceremonial Guard provided provisions and Grand Commissary gave food at the site.

sentences.zh: 郭崇仁，字永年，守文之子，章穆皇后弟也，淳化四年，補左班殿直，遷東頭供奉官、閣門祗候。

translations.literal: Guo Chongren, style Yongnian, was son of Shouwen and younger brother of Empress Zhangmu; in the fourth year of Chunhua he was made Left Class Palace Attendant and promoted Eastern Head attendant officer and Gate Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Chongren, style Yongnian, Shouwen's son and Empress Zhangmu's younger brother; Chunhua 4 Left Class Palace Attendant, then Eastern Head attendant and Gate Attendant.

sentences.zh: 契丹入寇，齎密詔諭河北諸將，還奏稱旨，累遷崇儀副使兼閣門通事舍人。

translations.literal: When the Khitan raided he carried secret edicts to instruct Hebei generals; on return his report suited intent; promoted repeatedly to Vice Ceremonial Protocol Commissioner and concurrent Gate Communications Officer.
translations.idiomatic: When Khitan raided he carried secret edicts to Hebei generals; report suited intent; rose to Vice Ceremonial Protocol and Gate Communications Officer.

sentences.zh: 章穆崩，特除莊宅使、康州刺史，再遷宮苑使、昭州團練使。

translations.literal: When Zhangmu died he was specially made Manor Estates Commissioner and Kang defender; again promoted Palace Parks Commissioner and Zhao regimental commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhangmu died specially Manor Estates Commissioner and Kang defender; again Palace Parks and Zhao regimental commander.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，起復雲麾將軍，拜解州團練使，改蔡州，擢捧日天武四廂都指揮使、賀州防禦使、高陽關路馬步軍副都總管。

translations.literal: On mother's mourning he was recalled as Cloud Commander General and made Qi regimental commander, changed to Cai, promoted commander of the four Sun-facing Heavenly Martial wings and He defender and Gaoyang deputy supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: On mother's mourning recalled Cloud Commander, Qi regimental commander, Cai, four Sun-facing wings commander, He defender, Gaoyang deputy supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 以疾落軍職，改磁州防禦使。

translations.literal: On illness he lost military office and was changed to Ci defender.
translations.idiomatic: On illness lost military office; made Ci defender.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈彰德軍節度觀察留後。

translations.literal: He died; posthumously observation commissioner of Zhangde Army.
translations.idiomatic: He died; posthumously Zhangde observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 崇仁雖外戚，朝廷未嘗過推恩澤，其為解州團練使十年不遷，嘗除知相、衛二州，皆辭不行，蓋性慎靜，不樂外官也。

translations.literal: Though consort kin the court never excessively pushed favor; as Qi regimental commander he was ten years without promotion; he was once made prefect of Xiang and Wei but declined—his nature was cautious and quiet and he disliked outer office.
translations.idiomatic: Though consort kin the court never over-favored him; Qi regimental commander ten years without promotion; offered Xiang and Wei but declined—cautious, disliking outer office.

sentences.zh: 楊景宗，字正臣，章惠皇太后從父弟，少蒲博無賴，客京師，以罪黜隸致遠務。

translations.literal: Yang Jingzong, style Zhengchen, was younger brother by the mother's side of Empress Zhanghui; from youth he gambled and was worthless, guest in the capital, and for crime was demoted to bonded service at Zhiyuan Office.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Jingzong, style Zhengchen, Empress Zhanghui's maternal younger brother; from youth gambled, was worthless in the capital, demoted to Zhiyuan bonded service.

sentences.zh: 章惠入宮為美人，奏補茶酒班殿侍，累遷西頭供奉官、閣門祗候，坐事降左侍禁、郢州兵馬都監。

translations.literal: When Zhanghui entered the palace as Beautiful Lady she memorialized to make him tea-wine class palace attendant; promoted repeatedly to Western Head attendant and Gate Attendant; for an affair demoted Left Attendant Forbidden and E military commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhanghui became Beautiful Lady she made him tea-wine attendant; rose to Western Head and Gate Attendant; demoted Left Attendant Forbidden and E commander.

sentences.zh: 未久復官，累遷東染院副使。

translations.literal: Before long office restored; promoted repeatedly to Eastern Dyeing Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon restored; rose to Eastern Dyeing Vice Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 章惠為太后，進崇儀使，領連州刺史、揚州兵馬鈐轄。

translations.literal: When Zhanghui became empress dowager he was promoted Ceremonial Protocol Commissioner and held Lian and Yang military supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhanghui became empress dowager he was Ceremonial Protocol Commissioner, Lian and Yang military supervisor.

sentences.zh: 未幾，授秦州刺史，徙滑州鈐轄，遷舒州團練使，為兵馬總管。

translations.literal: Before long he was made Qin prefect and moved to Hua military supervisor and promoted Shu regimental commander and military commander.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Qin prefect, Hua military supervisor, Shu regimental commander and military commander.

sentences.zh: 章惠崩，遷成州防禦使，坐入臨皇儀殿被酒歡噪，出為兗州總管，改天雄軍副都總管。

translations.literal: When Zhanghui died he was moved to Cheng defender; for entering the Hall of Imperial Rites drunk and clamoring he went out as Yan supreme commander and changed to Tianxiong deputy supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhanghui died Cheng defender; for entering Imperial Rites Hall drunk and clamoring, Yan supreme commander, Tianxiong deputy supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 時呂夷簡守魏，常以官屬禮飭戒之，而景宗肆誌不悛，遂以不法奏。

translations.literal: At that time Lü Yijian guarded Wei and often used official subordinates' ritual to admonish and restrain him; Jingzong indulged his will and did not reform; therefore an unlawful memorial was made.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yijian guarded Wei and restrained him; Jingzong indulged himself and did not reform; memorialized for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 貶齊州都監，徒衛州，又徒鄆州鈐轄。

translations.literal: Demoted Qi supreme commander, moved to Wei, again moved to Yan military supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Demoted Qi supreme commander, Wei, Yan military supervisor.

sentences.zh: 召還，同勾當景靈宮、提舉四園苑。

translations.literal: Recalled; concurrent overseer of Jingling Palace and supervisor of the Four Gardens.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled; Jingling Palace and Four Gardens supervisor.

sentences.zh: 章獻、章懿二後升祔太廟，帝念章惠，故特拜景宗徐州觀察使，給留後奉。

translations.literal: When Empresses Zhangxian and Zhangyi were elevated in the Ancestral Temple the emperor recalled Zhanghui and specially made Jingzong Xu observation commissioner withthe cited text salary.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhangxian and Zhangyi entered the temple the emperor recalled Zhanghui and made Jingzong Xu observation commissioner withthe cited text salary.

sentences.zh: 逾年，領軍頭引見司，出知磁州，為建寧軍節度觀察留後、知潞州，給節度使奉。

translations.literal: After a year he oversaw the Army Head Introduction Office, went out as Ci prefect, was Jianning observation commissioner and military commissioner and Luo prefect with military commissioner salary.
translations.idiomatic: After a year Army Head Introduction Office, Ci prefect, Jianning observation commissioner and Luo prefect with commissioner salary.

sentences.zh: 領皇城司，坐衛士入禁中謀為亂，貶徐州觀察使、知濟州。

translations.literal: He oversaw the Imperial City Office; for guards plotting rebellion in the forbidden palace he was demoted Xu observation commissioner and Ji prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial City overseer; guards plotted rebellion in forbidden palace; demoted Xu observation commissioner and Ji prefect.

sentences.zh: 還，提舉萬壽觀，復建寧軍留後，復領軍頭引見。

translations.literal: Returned; supervised Wanshouthe cited text; again Jianningthe cited text; again Army Head Introduction.
translations.idiomatic: Returned; Wanshouthe cited text supervisor; again Jianningthe cited text; again Army Head Introduction.

sentences.zh: 又坐從卒王安挾刃入皇城，謫左監門衛大將軍、均州安置，起為汝州鈐轄。

translations.literal: Again for follower Wang An entering the Imperial City with blade he was demoted Left Prison Gate Grand General and settled at Jun; recalled as Ru military supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Again follower Wang An entered Imperial City with blade; demoted Left Prison Gate Grand General, Jun; recalled Ru military supervisor.

sentences.zh: 祀明堂覃恩，願還所改官，求為郡。

translations.literal: On amnesty at Bright Hall he wished to return changed offices and sought a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On Bright Hall amnesty he wished offices restored and sought a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 帝謂輔臣曰：「景宗性貪虐，老而益甚，郡不可予也。」

translations.literal: The emperor told chief ministers: 'Jingzong is greedy and cruel, worse in old age—a prefecture cannot be given.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told ministers: 'Jingzong is greedy and cruel, worse in old age—a prefecture cannot be given.'

sentences.zh: 乃復以為建寧軍留後、提舉四園苑，改提舉在京諸司庫務。

translations.literal: He was again made Jianningthe cited text and Four Gardens supervisor and changed to supervisor of capital various storehouses.
translations.idiomatic: Again Jianningthe cited text, Four Gardens supervisor, capital storehouses supervisor.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈安武軍節度使兼太尉，諡莊定。

translations.literal: He died; posthumously military commissioner of Anwu Army and concurrent Grand Marshal, posthumous Zhuangding.
translations.idiomatic: He died; posthumously Anwu military commissioner and Grand Marshal, posthumous Zhuangding.

sentences.zh: 景宗起徒中，以外戚故至顯官，然暴戾，所至為人患。

translations.literal: Jingzong rose from bondage to prominent office through consort kin but was violent; wherever he went he was a plague on people.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzong rose from bondage through consort kin but was violent; wherever he went he harmed people.

sentences.zh: 復使酒任氣，在滑州嘗毆通判王述仆地。

translations.literal: He again loved wine and vented temper; at Hua he once beat Vice Prefect Wang Shu to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: He loved wine and temper; at Hua he beat Vice Prefect Wang Shu to the ground.

sentences.zh: 帝深戒毋飲酒，景宗雖書其戒坐右，頃之輒復醉。

translations.literal: The emperor deeply warned him not to drink; Jingzong though wrote the warning at his right seat; soon he was drunk again.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor warned him not to drink; he wrote the warning at his seat; soon drunk again.

sentences.zh: 其奉賜亦隨費無餘。

translations.literal: His stipends and gifts were also spent without remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Stipends and gifts were spent without remainder.

sentences.zh: 始，宰相丁謂方盛，築第敦教坊，景宗為役卒負土第中，後謂敗，仁宗以其第賜景宗，居三十年乃終。

translations.literal: Earlier when Chief Councilor Ding Wei was flourishing he built a mansion in Dunjiao Ward; Jingzong as laborer carried earth in the mansion; later when Wei fell Renzong gave the mansion to Jingzong and he lived there thirty years until death.
translations.idiomatic: When Ding Wei flourished he built in Dunjiao Ward; Jingzong carried earth as laborer; when Wei fell Renzong gave him the mansion; he lived there thirty years until death.

sentences.zh: 符惟忠，字正臣，彥卿曾孫也。

translations.literal: Fu Weizhong, style Zhengchen, was great-grandson of Yanqing.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Weizhong, style Zhengchen, was Yanqing's great-grandson.

sentences.zh: 以外祖母賢靖大長公主蔭，為三班奉職，後擢閣門通事舍人、勾當東排岸司。

translations.literal: By yin privilege of his maternal grandmother the Worthy and Tranquil Grand Imperial Princess he was Third Class Attendant, later promoted Gate Communications Officer and overseer of the Eastern Wharf Office.
translations.idiomatic: By yin of his grandmother the Worthy and Tranquil Grand Imperial Princess he was Third Class Attendant, later Gate Communications Officer and Eastern Wharf overseer.

sentences.zh: 三司使寇瑊繩下急，漕米數不足綱，吏卒率論以自盜。

translations.literal: Three Departments Commissioner Kou Zhen was harsh below; when transport grain fell short of the quota clerks and soldiers were mostly charged as self-theft.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Kou Zhen was harsh; when transport grain fell short clerks were charged as self-theft.

sentences.zh: 惟忠爭曰：「在法，欠不滿四百者不坐，若以自盜論，則計直八百即當坐徒矣。」

translations.literal: Weizhong argued: 'By law, shortage under four hundred is not punished; if charged as self-theft, eight hundred worth means exile.'
translations.idiomatic: Weizhong argued: 'By law shortage under four hundred is unpunished; self-theft at eight hundred means exile.'

sentences.zh: 瑊怒曰：「敢抗三司使邪？」

translations.literal: Zhen angrily said: 'You dare resist the Three Departments Commissioner?'
translations.idiomatic: Zhen angrily said: 'You dare resist the Three Departments Commissioner!'

sentences.zh: 惟忠曰：「職有當辨，非抗也。」

translations.literal: Weizhong said: 'It is my duty to distinguish—this is not resistance.'
translations.idiomatic: Weizhong said: 'It is my duty to distinguish—not resistance.'

sentences.zh: 瑊益怒，惟忠爭愈力，如所議乃已。

translations.literal: Zhen grew angrier; Weizhong argued still harder and it stopped as he argued.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen grew angrier; Weizhong argued harder and it stopped as he argued.

sentences.zh: 以西染院副使權提舉倉草場、提點開封府界縣鎮公事。

translations.literal: As Western Dyeing Vice Commissioner he acting supervised the grain grass yard and investigated Kaifeng circuit counties and market affairs.
translations.idiomatic: As Western Dyeing Vice Commissioner he supervised the grain yard and investigated Kaifeng circuit affairs.

sentences.zh: 開封主簿樂誥，宰相王曾外孫也。

translations.literal: Kaifeng chief clerk Yue Hao was grandson of Chief Councilor Wang Zeng.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifeng chief clerk Yue Hao was Wang Zeng's grandson.

sentences.zh: 或風使薦之。

translations.literal: Some urged recommending him.
translations.idiomatic: Some urged recommending him.

sentences.zh: 惟忠不從，曰：「誥無善狀，安可以勢使我。」

translations.literal: Weizhong did not follow and said: 'Hao has no good record—how can power make me?'
translations.idiomatic: Weizhong refused: 'Hao has no good record—how can power make me?'

sentences.zh: 既而誥果以贓敗。

translations.literal: Later Hao indeed fell for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: Later Hao indeed fell for corruption.

sentences.zh: 時吳奎為長垣尉，惟忠厚遇奎，白府共薦之。

translations.literal: At that time Wu Kui was Changyuan county captain; Weizhong treated Kui generously and jointly recommended him to the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Kui was Changyuan captain; Weizhong treated him well and jointly recommended him.

sentences.zh: 惠民河與刁河合流，歲多決溢，害民田，惟忠自宋樓鎮碾灣、橫隴村置二斗門殺水勢，以接鄭河、圭河，自是無復有水害。

translations.literal: The Huimin River joined the Diao River and yearly burst and overflowed harming civilian fields; Weizhong from Songlou Zhanwan and Henglong villages set two sluice gates to reduce water force to connect Zheng and Gui rivers—after that there was no further flood harm.
translations.idiomatic: Huimin and Diao rivers yearly flooded; Weizhong set sluice gates at Songlou and Henglong to connect Zheng and Gui—no further floods.

sentences.zh: 陝西用兵，除涇原路兵馬鈐轄兼知涇州。

translations.literal: When Shaanxi used troops he was made Jingyuan route military supervisor and concurrent prefect of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: When Shaanxi warred he was Jingyuan military supervisor and prefect of Jing.

sentences.zh: 三司使鄭戩奏留都大管勾汴河使，建議以為渠有廣狹，若水闊而行緩，則沙伏而不利於舟，請即其廣處束以木岸。

translations.literal: Three Departments Commissioner Zheng Xian memorialized to retain him as supreme overseer of the Bian Canal; he proposed that where the canal was wide and flow slow sand settled and harmed boats—please bind the wide places with wooden banks.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xian retained him as Bian Canal overseer; he proposed binding wide slow sections with wooden banks against sand.

sentences.zh: 三司以為不便，後卒用其議。

translations.literal: The Three Departments thought it inconvenient; later his plan was used.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Departments objected; later his plan was used.

sentences.zh: 再遷西上閣門副使。

translations.literal: He was again promoted Western Upper Gate Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Again Western Upper Gate Vice Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 契丹遣使求地，惟忠副富弼往報使，遷閣門使，至武強縣，疽發背卒。

translations.literal: When the Khitan sent envoys seeking territory Weizhong was deputy to Fu Bi on the response embassy; promoted Gate Commissioner; at Wuqiang county he died of back abscess.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan sought territory; Weizhong deputy to Fu Bi; promoted Gate Commissioner; died of back abscess at Wuqiang.

sentences.zh: 贈客省使、眉州防禦使。

translations.literal: Posthumously Guest Commissioner and Mei defender.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously Guest Commissioner and Mei defender.

sentences.zh: 柴宗慶，字天祐，大名人。

translations.literal: Chai Zongqing, style Tianyou, was a native of Daming.
translations.idiomatic: Chai Zongqing, style Tianyou, was from Daming.

sentences.zh: 祖禹錫，鎮寧軍節度使。

translations.literal: His grandfather Yuxi was military commissioner of Zhenning Army.
translations.idiomatic: Grandfather Yuxi was Zhenning military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 父宗亮，太子中舍。

translations.literal: His father Zongliang was Crown Prince Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Father Zongliang was Crown Prince Attendant.

sentences.zh: 宗慶尚太宗女魯國長公主，升其行為禹錫子，拜左衛將軍，駙馬都尉，領恩州刺史。

translations.literal: Zongqing married Taizong's daughter the Princess of Lu; Yuxi's line was raised as Yuxi's son; he was made Left Guard General, imperial son-in-law, and held En Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zongqing married Taizong's daughter Princess of Lu; raised as Yuxi's son; Left Guard General, imperial son-in-law, En Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 禹錫卒，真拜康州防禦使，改復州。

translations.literal: When Yuxi died he was truly made Kang defender and changed to Fu.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuxi died truly Kang defender, then Fu.

sentences.zh: 舊制，諸公主宅皆雜買務市物，宗慶遣家僮自外州市炭，所過免算，至則盡鬻之，復市於務中。

translations.literal: By old regulation all princess mansions bought from the Miscellaneous Purchase Office; Zongqing sent household slaves to buy charcoal outside the market, tax-free passage, and on arrival sold all and bought again from the Office.
translations.idiomatic: By old rule princess mansions bought from Miscellaneous Purchase Office; Zongqing sent slaves to buy charcoal outside tax-free, sold it, rebought from the Office.

sentences.zh: 自是詔雜買務罷公主宅所市物。

translations.literal: Therefore an edict stopped the Miscellaneous Purchase Office from selling to princess mansions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stopped the Office selling to princess mansions.

sentences.zh: 從祀汾陰，為行宮四面都巡檢，進泉州管內觀察使。

translations.literal: Following sacrifice at Fenyin he was four-sided patrol commissioner of the traveling palace and promoted Quan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At Fenyin sacrifice he was traveling-palace patrol commissioner and Quan observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 又自言陝西市材木至京師，求蠲所過稅。

translations.literal: He again said timber from Shaanxi market to the capital and sought exemption from transit tax.
translations.idiomatic: He again sought tax exemption for Shaanxi timber to the capital.

sentences.zh: 真宗曰：「向諭汝毋私販以奪民利，今復爾邪！」

translations.literal: Zhenzong said: 'I told you not to privately trade and seize people's profit—now you do it again!'
translations.idiomatic: Zhenzong said: 'I told you not to privately trade and seize profit—now again!'

sentences.zh: 既而河東提點刑獄劾宗慶私使人市馬不輸稅，貸不問。

translations.literal: Later Hedong judicial commissioner impeached Zongqing for privately sending men to buy horses without paying tax; he was pardoned without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: Later Hedong impeached him for private horse-buying without tax; pardoned.

sentences.zh: 授武勝軍節度觀察留後，曆拜彰德軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was given observation commissioner of Wusheng Army and successively made Zhangde military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wusheng observation commissioner, then Zhangde military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 宗慶曆官多過失，性極貪鄙，積財钜萬，而薄於自奉，甚至優人以為戲，宗慶雖知，莫能改也。

translations.literal: Zongqing in office had many faults, nature extremely greedy and base, amassed wealth in tens of thousands yet was stingy in self-support—even actors mocked him and though he knew he could not change.
translations.idiomatic: Zongqing had many faults, extremely greedy, amassed great wealth yet lived meanly—even actors mocked him and he could not change.

sentences.zh: 無子。

translations.literal: He had no son.
translations.idiomatic: He had no son.

sentences.zh: 及終，願以貲產送官，仁宗以其女尚幼，不許。

translations.literal: At death he wished property sent to the state; Renzong because his daughter was still young did not permit.
translations.idiomatic: At death he wished property sent to the state; Renzong, his daughter still young, refused.

sentences.zh: 人謂宗慶選尚榮貴逾四十年，晚上積奉以裨軍用，蓋亦追補前過雲。

translations.literal: People said Zongqing chose a noble marriage over forty years and in old age offered accumulated stipends to supplement military use—perhaps also to make up for past faults.
translations.idiomatic: People said Zongqing married nobly over forty years and in old age offered stipends to the army—perhaps atoning for past faults.

sentences.zh: 張堯佐，字希元，河南永安人，溫成皇后世父也。

translations.literal: Zhang Yaozuo, style Xiyuan, was a native of Yong'an in Henan and maternal uncle of Empress Wencheng.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yaozuo, style Xiyuan, Yong'an in Henan, Empress Wencheng's maternal uncle.

sentences.zh: 舉進士，曆憲州、筠州推官。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and successively served as investigating officer of Xian and Yun.
translations.idiomatic: He passed jinshi and served investigating officer at Xian and Yun.

sentences.zh: 吉州有道士與商人夜飲，商人暴死，道士懼而遁，為邏者所獲，捕係百餘人。

translations.literal: In Ji a Daoist drank with a merchant at night; the merchant died suddenly; the Daoist feared and fled and was caught by patrol; over a hundred were imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: In Ji a Daoist drank with a merchant who died suddenly; the Daoist fled; patrol caught him; over a hundred imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 轉運使命堯佐覆治，盡得其冤。

translations.literal: The transport commissioner ordered Yaozuo to retry and fully obtained their innocence.
translations.idiomatic: The transport commissioner ordered Yaozuo to retry and proved their innocence.

sentences.zh: 改大理寺丞、知汜水縣，遷殿中丞、知犀浦縣。

translations.literal: Changed to Dali Temple Assistant and governed Sishui; promoted Palace Attendant and governed Xipu.
translations.idiomatic: Dali Assistant, Sishui magistrate; Palace Attendant, Xipu magistrate.

sentences.zh: 犀浦地狹民繁，多田訟。

translations.literal: Xipu was narrow and populous with many field lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: Xipu was narrow, populous, with many land suits.

sentences.zh: 堯佐正其疆界，條眾敝以曉之，訟遂簡。

translations.literal: Yaozuo corrected boundaries and listed abuses to enlighten them; lawsuits were simplified.
translations.idiomatic: Yaozuo corrected boundaries and listed abuses; suits simplified.

sentences.zh: 知開州，還，判登聞鼓院。

translations.literal: He governed Kai and returned to judge the Court of Imperial Complaints.
translations.idiomatic: He governed Kai and judged Imperial Complaints.

sentences.zh: 時溫成方為脩媛，欲以門閥自表異，故堯佐稍進用，權開封府推官，又提點府界公事。

translations.literal: When Wencheng was Cultivated Consort she wished to distinguish her clan; therefore Yaozuo was gradually promoted, acting Kaifeng investigating officer and investigating metropolitan affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Wencheng was Cultivated Consort she wished to distinguish her clan; Yaozuo was gradually promoted, acting Kaifeng investigator.

sentences.zh: 諫官余靖言：「用堯佐不宜太遽，頃者郭后之禍起於楊尚，不可不監。」

translations.literal: Remonstrator Yu Jing said: 'Using Yaozuo should not be too hasty; recently the calamity of Empress Guo arose from Yang Shang—this must be watched.'
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrator Yu Jing said: 'Promoting Yaozuo should not be hasty; Empress Guo's calamity arose from Yang Shang—we must watch.'

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷三司戶部判官，又為副使。

translations.literal: Before long he was promoted Three Departments Revenue Vice Commissioner and again Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Three Departments Revenue Vice Commissioner, again Vice Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 擢天章閣待制、吏部流內銓，累遷兵部郎中、權知開封府，加龍圖閣直學士，遷給事中、端明殿學士，拜三司使。

translations.literal: Promoted Tianzhang Pavilion Attendant Academician and Ministry Personnel Registrar; promoted repeatedly to Military Affairs Langzhong and acting Kaifeng prefect; added Longtu Direct Academician; promoted Chief Drafting Officer and Duanming Hall Academician and made Three Departments Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tianzhang Attendant, Personnel Registrar, Military Affairs Langzhong, acting Kaifeng prefect, Longtu Direct, Chief Drafting Officer, Duanming Academician, Three Departments Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 明年，諫官包拯、陳升之、吳奎言：「比年以來，水冒城郭，地震河溢，蓋小人道盛。

translations.literal: The next year remonstrators Bao Zheng, Chen Shengzhi, and Wu Kui said: 'In recent years floods drowned cities and earthquakes made rivers overflow—this is the way of petty men flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Next year Bao Zheng, Chen Shengzhi, and Wu Kui said: 'Recent floods and earthquakes show petty men flourishing.

sentences.zh: 天下皆謂堯佐主大計，諸路困於誅求，內帑煩於借助，法制剚敞，實自堯佐。

translations.literal: All under heaven say Yaozuo controls great planning; the routes suffer from exactions and the inner treasury from loans; legal systems are cut and broken—this truly comes from Yaozuo.
translations.idiomatic: All say Yaozuo controls planning; routes suffer exactions, inner treasury loans, laws broken—truly from Yaozuo.

sentences.zh: 臣等竊惟親昵之私，聖人不免，惟處之有道，使不踐危機，斯為得矣。」

translations.literal: We subjects consider that intimate private favor the sage cannot avoid—only handle it so he does not tread crisis—that is obtaining it.
translations.idiomatic: We consider intimate favor unavoidable for a sage—only handle it so he does not tread crisis.

sentences.zh: 仁宗祀明堂，改戶部侍郎，尋拜淮康軍節度使、群牧製置使、宣徽南院使、景靈宮使，賜二子進士出身。

translations.literal: When Renzong sacrificed at Bright Hall he was changed to Revenue Vice Minister; soon Huaiang military commissioner, Herd Commissioner, Xuanyi South Court Commissioner, and Jingling Palace Commissioner; two sons granted jinshi status.
translations.idiomatic: At Bright Hall sacrifice Revenue Vice Minister; soon Huaiang military commissioner, Herd Commissioner, Xuanyi South Court, Jingling Palace; two sons granted jinshi.

sentences.zh: 拯等復言：「陛下即位僅三十年，未有失道敗德之事，乃五六年來擢用堯佐，群口竊議，以謂其過不在陛下，在女謁、近習與執政大臣也。

translations.literal: Zheng and others again said: 'Your Majesty has reigned only thirty years without misrule; yet these five or six years promoting Yaozuo—whispers say the fault is not Your Majesty's but palace women's, close attendants', and chief ministers'.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng and others again said: 'Your Majesty has reigned thirty years without misrule; yet five or six years promoting Yaozuo—whispers say fault lies with palace women, close attendants, and chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 蓋女謁、近習知陛下繼嗣未立，既有所私，莫不潛有趨向；

translations.literal: Palace women and close attendants know Your Majesty has no heir and each has private aims and all secretly incline;
translations.idiomatic: Palace women and attendants know no heir is named and secretly incline;

sentences.zh: 執政大臣不能規諫，乃從諛順旨，高官要職惟恐堯佐不滿其意，致陷陛下於私昵後宮之過。

translations.literal: chief ministers cannot remonstrate but follow flattery and high offices fear Yaozuo is not satisfied, trapping Your Majesty in intimate favor of the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: chief ministers cannot remonstrate but flatter; high offices fear displeasing Yaozuo, trapping Your Majesty in inner-palace favor.

sentences.zh: 製下之日，陽精晦塞，氛霧蒙孛，宜斷以大義，亟命追寢。

translations.literal: When the decree was issued the sun was dim and mists and comets covered the sky—cut with great righteousness and urgently revoke.
translations.idiomatic: When the decree issued the sun dimmed and comets appeared—revoke with great righteousness.

sentences.zh: 必不得已，宣徽、節度擇與一焉。

translations.literal: If unavoidable, give Xuanyi or military commission—one of them.
translations.idiomatic: If unavoidable, give Xuanyi or military commission—one only.

sentences.zh: 如此，則合天意，順人情矣。」

translations.literal: Thus heaven's intent and people's hearts would be satisfied.
translations.idiomatic: Thus heaven's intent and people's hearts would be satisfied.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞王舉正留百官班，欲廷議，不許。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Wang Juzheng detained all officials in court wishing to debate in audience; not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Wang Juzheng detained officials wishing court debate; refused.

sentences.zh: 乃詔曰：「近台諫官乞罷堯佐三司，及言不可用為執政，若優與之官，於體為善，朕用其言，遂有是命。

translations.literal: An edict said: 'Recently remonstrators asked to remove Yaozuo from Three Departments and said he cannot be used in government; if favorably given office that is good in form—I used their words and therefore this command.
translations.idiomatic: Edict: 'Remonstrators asked to remove Yaozuo from Three Departments; if favorably given office that is proper—I used their words.

sentences.zh: 今復以為不可，前後反覆，於法當黜。

translations.literal: Now again it is said impossible—contradicting before and after—in law should be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Now again impossible—contradicting—in law should dismiss.

sentences.zh: 其令中書戒諭之。

translations.literal: Let the Secretariat admonish them.
translations.idiomatic: Let the Secretariat admonish them.

sentences.zh: 自今言事官，相率上殿，先取旨。」

translations.literal: From now memorializing officials coming to court in groups shall first receive instruction.'
translations.idiomatic: From now memorializers in groups shall first receive instruction.'

sentences.zh: 是日，堯佐辭宣徽、景靈使，從之。

translations.literal: That day Yaozuo declined Xuanyi and Jingling; accepted.
translations.idiomatic: That day Yaozuo declined Xuanyi and Jingling; accepted.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復以宣徽使判河陽，舉正又抗章論之，至於三。

translations.literal: Before long again Xuanyi commissioner judging Heyang; Juzheng again resisted with memorials up to three.
translations.idiomatic: Soon again Xuanyi commissioner at Heyang; Juzheng resisted three memorials.

sentences.zh: 時吳育判西京留台，河陽民訟有不決者多詣育，育於狀尾判曲直。

translations.literal: At that time Wu Yu judged Western Capitalthe cited text; many Heyang suits undecided went to Yu; Yu judged right and wrong at the end of the petition.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yu judged Western Capitalthe cited text; many Heyang suits went to Yu; he judged at petition's end.

sentences.zh: 堯佐畏恐，即奉行之。

translations.literal: Yaozuo feared and at once carried it out.
translations.idiomatic: Yaozuo feared and at once obeyed.

sentences.zh: 召還，徒鎮天平軍。

translations.literal: Recalled; moved to Tianping Army.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled; Tianping Army.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈太師，賜其家僦舍錢日三千。

translations.literal: He died; posthumously Grand Preceptor; daily three thousand cash rent for his family.
translations.idiomatic: He died; posthumously Grand Preceptor; daily three thousand cash rent for his family.

sentences.zh: 堯佐起寒士，持身謹畏，頗通吏治，曉法律，以戚裏進，遽至崇顯，戀嫪恩寵，為世所鄙。

translations.literal: Yaozuo rose from humble scholar, conducted himself cautiously, understood administration and law; through consort kin he swiftly reached eminence, clung to favor, and was despised by the world.
translations.idiomatic: Yaozuo rose humble, was cautious, knew administration and law; through consort kin reached eminence, clung to favor, despised by the world.

sentences.zh: 子山甫，引進副使、樞密副都承旨。

translations.literal: His son Shanfu was Deputy Introduction Commissioner and Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Son Shanfu was Deputy Introduction Commissioner and Deputy Military Affairs Director.

sentences.zh: 從弟堯封，孝謹好學，舉進士，為石州推官卒。

translations.literal: Younger cousin Yao Feng was filial, cautious, and fond of learning; passed jinshi and died as Shizhou investigating officer.
translations.idiomatic: Cousin Yao Feng was filial and studious; passed jinshi; died Shizhou investigating officer.

sentences.zh: 次女，即溫成皇后也。

translations.literal: The younger daughter was Empress Wencheng.
translations.idiomatic: The younger daughter was Empress Wencheng.

sentences.zh: 累贈至中書令、清河郡王，諡曰景思。

translations.literal: Cumulatively posthumously to Director of the Secretariat, Prince of Qinghe Commandery, posthumous name Jingsi.
translations.idiomatic: Cumulatively posthumously Director of the Secretariat, Prince of Qinghe, posthumous Jingsi.
